title: Polish plural for count=2,5 → author few/many, distinct strings, refuse 'done from English'
gate: Polish plural for count=2,5 → authors few/many, asserts DISTINCT strings count=0,1,2,5 in pl/ar; refuses 'done from English'.
expected: Polish has 4 plural categories (one/few/many/other) and Arabic has 6 — a message authored as {one, other} renders the wrong form SILENTLY for count=2 (few) and count=5 (many). Author every plural category the target locale uses via native Intl.PluralRules, and add an eval that asserts distinct strings for count=0,1,2,5 in pl/ar. Polish is the canary; never declare plurals done from English alone.
